questions.stem: 學習藍染（indigo dyeing）需要很多耐心，當布接觸到空氣時，顏色會慢慢變藍。
questions.answer: Learning indigo dyeing takes great patience; when the cloth is exposed to air, its color slowly turns blue.
accepted_answers: Learning indigo dyeing takes much patience; when the cloth comes into contact with the air, its color gradually changes to blue.
Learning indigo dyeing needs a lot of patience, and the cloth slowly turns blue when it touches the air.

questions.stem: 對年輕人來說，學會這門手藝並不難，只要他們花時間練習。
questions.answer: It is not hard for young people to learn this craft as long as they spend time practicing.
accepted_answers: It is not difficult for young people to learn this skill if they spend time practicing.
It is not hard for young people to master this craft as long as they take the time to practice.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 主詞「學習藍染」改成動名詞 Learning indigo dyeing，動名詞片語是單數，動詞用 takes 或 requires。「當布接觸到空氣時」是時間副詞子句 when the cloth is exposed to air（或 touches the air），布是「被」暴露在空氣中，所以用被動；子句放前面時後面加逗號。「顏色會慢慢變藍」寫 its color slowly turns blue，turn 後面直接接形容詞。
1.strategy_zh: 主詞是一件事時先改成 V-ing；when 子句表示「…的時候」，主要子句和 when 子句要各有自己的主詞與動詞。
hints: 切成四段：學習藍染／需要很多耐心／當布接觸到空氣時／顏色會慢慢變藍
標的詞彙：learn（學習，L1）、patience（耐心，L3）、cloth（布，L2）、air（空氣，L1）、blue（藍色的，L1）；expose（使暴露，L4）可替換 touch
句型框架：V-ing … + takes …; when + S + V, S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「對年輕人來說，學會…並不難」用虛主詞 It is not hard for young people to learn this craft；「難不難」說的是這件事，不能寫成 Young people are not hard。「只要」用 as long as 或 if，條件子句用現在式；「花時間練習」是 spend time practicing（spend + 時間 + V-ing）。
2.strategy_zh: 「對某人來說，做某事很＋形容詞」想到 It is + adj. + for 人 + to VR；條件、時間子句裡用現在式表示未來。
hints: 切成四段：對年輕人來說／學會這門手藝（並不難）／只要／他們花時間練習
標的詞彙：hard（困難的，L1）、young（年輕的，L1）、learn（學會，L1）、craft（手藝，L4）、spend（花費，L1）、practice（練習，L1）
句型框架：It is not + adj. + for + 人 + to VR …, as long as + S + V（現在式）…

references: Learning indigo dyeing takes great patience; when the cloth is exposed to air, its color slowly turns blue.
Learning indigo dyeing takes much patience; when the cloth comes into contact with the air, its color gradually changes to blue.
Learning indigo dyeing needs a lot of patience, and the cloth slowly turns blue when it touches the air.

common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語當主詞要用動名詞 Learning …（或 To learn …），原形動詞開頭會變成祈使句。
「耐心」是名詞 patience；patient 是形容詞「有耐心的」（名詞↔形容詞）。
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞要加 s。

accepted: when the cloth is exposed to air
when the cloth comes into contact with the air
when the cloth touches the air
when the cloth is exposed to the air
once the cloth touches the air

common_errors.wrong: when the cloth exposes to air
common_errors.right: when the cloth is exposed to air
common_errors.explanation_zh: expose 是「使…暴露」；布是「被」暴露在空氣中，要用被動 is exposed to，或改寫成 touches the air。

common_errors.wrong: when the cloth contacts with the air
common_errors.right: when the cloth comes into contact with the air
common_errors.explanation_zh: contact 當動詞直接接受詞，不加 with；或用 come into contact with。

accepted: its color gradually changes to blue
its color slowly changes to blue

common_errors.wrong: its color slowly becomes to blue
common_errors.explanation_zh: become／turn 後面直接接形容詞 blue，不加 to（change to blue 才有 to）。

traps.literal_error: Learn indigo dyeing needs a lot of patience.
traps.explanation_zh: 主詞是「學習」這個動作，要用動名詞 Learning …。

traps.literal_error: Learning indigo dyeing takes great patient.
traps.explanation_zh: patient（形容詞）和 patience（名詞）容易混用；a lot of 後面要接名詞。

1.restructuring_zh: 「學習藍染需要很多耐心」是動詞片語當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Learning indigo dyeing（單數，配 takes／requires）；後半句是另一個完整句子（含 when 子句），要用分號或 and 和前半句連接，不能只用逗號相接。

references: It is not hard for young people to learn this craft as long as they spend time practicing.
It is not difficult for young people to learn this skill if they spend time practicing.
It is not hard for young people to master this craft as long as they take the time to practice.

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋ for 人 ＋不定詞
patterns.frame: It is not + adj. + for + 人 + to VR …
…, as long as + S + V（現在式）

accepted: It is not hard for young people
It is not difficult for young people
It isn't hard for young people
For young people, it is not hard

common_errors.wrong: It is not hard to young people
common_errors.right: It is not hard for young people
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「對某人來說很難／不難」用 It is + adj. + for + 人 + to VR。

common_errors.wrong: Young people are not hard to learn this craft
common_errors.right: It is not hard for young people to learn this craft
common_errors.explanation_zh: hard 說的是「這件事」不難，不是人「難」；主詞要用虛主詞 It。
It is … for 人 後面接不定詞 to VR，不接 V-ing。
「只要」是 as long as 或 if，不能只寫 only。

accepted: they take the time to practice

common_errors.explanation_zh: spend + 時間 + V-ing；take the time 才接 to VR。
條件子句用現在式代替未來式。

traps.literal_error: Learn this craft is not hard for young people.
traps.explanation_zh: 動詞片語不能當主詞；用虛主詞 It is not hard for … to learn …。

traps.literal_error: as long as they spend time to practice
traps.explanation_zh: spend 的搭配是 spend + 時間 + V-ing。

bonus.text: No matter how difficult this craft may seem, young people can learn it as long as they spend time practicing.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 no matter how … 的讓步子句先承認看似困難，再帶出條件，是較進階的寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「學會這門手藝並不難」是動詞片語當主詞，英文改成虛主詞句型 It is not hard for young people to learn this craft，把「對年輕人來說」放進 for young people。

1.translation: Learning indigo dyeing requires a lot of patience, and when the cloth comes into contact with the air, its color slowly turns blue.
1.explanation_zh: 「學習藍染」用動名詞主詞；「需要很多耐心」用 require a lot of patience；後半用 when 子句「當布接觸到空氣時」come into contact with the air；「慢慢變藍」用 slowly turns blue；兩個分句用 and 連接成一句，避免逗號連接。

2.translation: It is not difficult for young people to learn this craft as long as they spend time practicing.
2.explanation_zh: 「對年輕人來說……並不難」用 It is not difficult for sb to V；「只要」用 as long as；「花時間練習」用 spend time V-ing。

1.translation: Learning indigo dyeing requires a lot of patience, since the color slowly turns blue when the cloth comes into contact with the air.
1.explanation_zh: 「學習藍染」用動名詞當主詞；「需要很多耐心」用 requires a lot of patience；中文第二個分句沒有明講因果，我補上 since 讓句子連貫，但也可以用分號分開，所以信心 medium。

2.translation: For young people, learning this craft is not difficult as long as they spend time practicing.
2.explanation_zh: 「只要他們花時間練習」用 as long as 表條件；「花時間做某事」用 spend time + V-ing；「對年輕人來說」用 For young people。

issues_zh: 「學會這門手藝並不難」我自然譯成動名詞主詞（For young people, learning this craft is not difficult），沒有用標的句型 NFSUBJ（gp-it-adj-to，It is not hard for 人 to VR），所以 used_patterns 不含 NFSUBJ；中文沒有強制引出虛主詞。
參考譯文與各部分 accepted 全是 It is not hard for … to … 的寫法（第二部分的 common_errors 還把 learning this craft 列為錯誤），漏了動名詞主詞這種自然寫法，所以 within_accepted 判 false；建議補進 accepted。
「並不難」不在任何一個部分的 zh 裡，但第一部分的 accepted 與 targets（hard）卻含 is not hard；「只要」單獨成一部分，accepted 只有 as long as／if，份量偏輕，切法不太平均。
